decision_basis.writer_domain: Real unchanged Ledger.register enters L3 outside the proposed admission/L1/L2 domain. It successfully creates budget.json.pending containing A0_UNENROLLED_REGISTER before pinned main-ledger replacement fails with PermissionError/WinError5. Main-ledger bytes and inherited attempt array remain unchanged. This demonstrates membership-exclusion failure for the tested arrangement; it neither establishes all possible A/S implementations impossible nor demonstrates an F01 certification bypass.
decision_basis.research: I/X can retain scientifically useful per-source or independently bound group observations without a common cut. It cannot establish the mission's complete comparable run-cost endpoint or a new v2.1 eligible terminal view. Current native and architecture recording paths have different crash durability and timing scopes and remain canned/offline. Broad production writer enrollment is not yet shown to be the unique minimal remedy. One bounded feasibility slice must resolve operational exclusion and original six-condition endpoint coverage before choosing that remedy.

authority_and_certification_limits.detected_candidate_cut: Aborted/unstable test arrangement; retain only independently justified lower facts
authority_and_certification_limits.collector_inventory: Non-atomic A0 evidence inventory, not production common-cut capture
authority_and_certification_limits.legacy_source: Existing APIs and source artifacts remain unchanged. Their own independent completed verification must actually pass; a report field or local hash is not sufficient.
authority_and_certification_limits.v21_eligible_view: NORMAL and RESTRICTED require unchanged source verification at the same genuine A/S guarded membership/content cut. A separately valid legacy artifact plus I/X observations cannot produce such a view.
authority_and_certification_limits.v21_diagnostic: Only a recognized grounded noncertifying diagnostic or the actual typed operational/integrity error is available without the required cut. No diagnostic certified candidate selection or normal publication.
authority_and_certification_limits.complete_accounting: Under the approved new contract, COMPLETE requires A plus independently VERIFIED eligible source and full raw/usage/settlement/closure coverage. A anchored recorded-identity count alone is not complete cost or inference.
authority_and_certification_limits.lower_observations: Name exact source/group, raw-byte reference, origin, identity, capture scope, consistency and missing dimensions. I cannot assert historical completeness, graph-wide totals or absence. X is unsupported observations, not observed zero.
authority_and_certification_limits.candidates: Retain actual supported original IDs/content/attempt/handle/lineage only. Missing original C0 or final remains missing. Diagnostic candidates remain observed and unselected.
authority_and_certification_limits.provider_origin: Local hashes, copied fixtures, recorded reservations, model agreement and graph cardinality do not authenticate provider inference or billing.
authority_and_certification_limits.retained_gates: Existing F01/F02/F03/F04 certification and retained R5 controls remain mandatory; no documentary or collector PASS discharges future runtime acceptance.

experiment_decision.incomplete_cost_rule: Any missing, uncertain, conflicting or differently scoped relevant total blocks that comparison or must remain explicitly INCOMPLETE. No estimated usage, zero filling, partial-subset efficiency ranking, silent failed-cell exclusion or inferred monetary billing.
experiment_decision.narrower_endpoint_limit: A future prespecified quality-only endpoint might use independently eligible unchanged legacy source and frozen external evaluation while I/X diagnostics remain partial. This review does not substitute that narrower endpoint for the mission's full resource comparison.

exact_next_scope.objective: Resolve once whether one precisely declared single-host post-generation operational profile, with unchanged production APIs, can exhaustively admit/drain/exclude every supported producer and inner-lock user and bind original six-condition source/closure/usage evidence for the stated endpoints. Otherwise return the exact failed edge and smallest separately reviewable enrollment or recording boundary.
positive_gates: Original six-condition source identity/candidate/closure and physical-exchange evidence census
One exhaustive justified producer disposition before L1/L2
Actual-ledger identity and finite nonrecursive native guard behavior
Legitimate unchanged-core eligibility in nonowning mode
negative_gates: Missing or copied/rebased evidence cannot invent execution origin or C0
Unenrolled direct Ledger/finally/native writers or UNKNOWN coverage prevent A/S
Missing/uncertain usage never becomes zero or COMPLETE
Aliases, ungrounded context, stale/foreign reports and genuine BLOCKED evidence reject without weaker verification
No recursive L3/D, mutable constructors, input-event logging, owner/fence change, replay, budget reset or hidden provider/scorer activity
exact_next_scope.preservation: Read original sources, contracts, Engine, Harness, frozen evaluator, algorithms, prompts, historical tests, all original evidence and Git/index state only. Write solely new test-only files and fresh synthetic/output paths. Preserve original failures and exact observed exits.
stop_conditions: Stop after the finite single-profile gate set; no iterate-until-green
Any outside-profile mutation or unproved writer disposition blocks strong feasibility
Any protected edit, dependency/live requirement, unbounded wait, owner/fence change, contradictory identity or unreadable required evidence stops the slice
Need for source repair/replay/budget reset or weaker certification stops the slice
Actual-provider compatibility remains NOT_ESTABLISHED; no live run follows from offline synthetic success
exact_next_scope.independent_acceptance: A fresh reviewer separate from feasibility author and collector author must inspect actual original sources, all six endpoint rows, coverage argument, raw command/PID/phase/exit/join evidence and preservation; require a legitimate positive and honest negative gates. A source/process census or synthetic success alone does not prove all-writer exclusion.
exact_next_scope.why_minimal: A diagnostic-only implementation leaves a required cost endpoint unsatisfied. Immediate broad writer edits commit to an invasive remedy before testing whether a closed operational profile and existing evidence suffice. This finite feasibility decision identifies the minimal exact source boundary without weakening accepted safety.
